lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Rwanda administrative units. The spatial data represents acute food insecurity phase classifications for July 2011 medium-term projections, with multiple scenarios and assistance requirements documented for each geographic unit.
